edits.old: And the case stays with operations
edits.new:
And the case stays with operations

  Scenario: AC6 A consumed event redelivered is applied once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the TreatmentApproved event for treatment "T-0001" has been consumed
    When the same TreatmentApproved event is delivered again
    Then the booking is not posted a second time
    And no second outbound item is created for the treatment

  Scenario: AC7 A consumed call that fails or does not answer is not recorded as posted (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the ALS call for the booking of treatment "T-0001" fails or does not answer
    When the booking step runs
    Then no booking reference is recorded on the case
    And the outbound item is retried under BR5

  Scenario: AC8 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the case for treatment "T-0001" is in a state from which the booking transition is not allowed
    When the booking step attempts that transition
    Then the transition is refused
    And no outbound item is created
